chunks: Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from Bunān ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Ibn al-Mughīrah, from al-Sukūnī, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from ʿAlī عليه السلام:
Concerning a man who made a bequest of his one-third, then was killed by mistake, he said: one-third of his blood-money is included in his bequest.

key_terms.أَوْصَى: made a bequest or testamentary instruction
key_terms.بِثُلُثِهِ: with respect to one-third of his estate

ai.seo_question: If someone made a bequest of one-third of his estate and was then killed accidentally, is one-third of the diyah included in the will?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a person who had already made a bequest of one-third of his estate and was later killed unintentionally. It states that one-third of the diyah paid for his accidental killing is included within that bequest, showing that the diyah is treated as part of what is subject to the testamentary one-third.
